title: Bind signed schema verification v2 to the Durable Authorized Injection Registry

phases.objective: Retain attestation v2 and its exact Durable Authorized Injection Registry binding while extending the four-wave readback from 68 to all 71 critical columns, including the three promoted timestamp columns.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The canonical four-wave readback v4 plus synthetic successful migration ledger evidence
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A synthetic Ed25519 v2 signature verifies, v1 replay fails closed, verified evidence retains the exact Durable Injection registry schema, and the readback requires both state timestamps plus the rollback timestamp for 71 critical columns.
steps: Retain the canonical dedicated readback v4 file and its 17-table and 31-index-column expectations.
Raise the exact critical runtime-column count from 68 to 71.
Retain exact readback of 13 Durable Authorized Injection constraints and the canonical schema digest.
Retain the v2 subject, predicate, attestation schema, and evidence identities.
Reject any v1 attestation before signature verification.
Verify one synthetic Ed25519 signature using public-key material only.
Reject timestamp, schema digest, table, constraint, ledger, signature, parity, timing, and secret drift.
assertions: The verifier retains exactly four migration waves and readback v4.
The readback proves exactly two created_at datetime fields and one updated_at datetime field across the two Durable Injection tables.
The authorized injection schema digest equals 652b2d50774944c4f21d92fd8a461c0e0cd18316e5875696223337eb2df5555a.
The verified schema evidence contains both exact Durable Injection tables and 13 constraints.
No private key, live database access, live signature, migration Apply, provider dispatch, deployment, main merge, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Perform live readback and external signing only after separately governed four-wave Apply evidence exists.
Reject stale, replayed, mismatched, or expired live signatures across restart reconciliation.
Verify one separately authorized non-production v2 signed schema canary.
This repository-only verifier hardening grants no deployment, main, or Production authority.
